Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

We're a small nonprofit organization ([URL_001]) launching a YouTube channel, and we need a thumbnail for our first video. Ideally, we would like it ready by the start of next week, on monday or tuesday. We would prefer that the thumbnail contain no AI assets, though minor AI-assisted edits such as generative fill in photoshop are probably okay. Would you be able to help?
